project_info.name: MyNews - AI News Engine & Hindi Publishing Platform
project_info.primary_language: Hindi (Devanagari script) with English UI toggles for Admin
project_info.target_audience: Hindi news readers seeking verified, high-quality rephrased news; Editorial team & admin moderators supervising AI processing pipeline

design_archetype.name: SWISS EDITORIAL & HIGH-CONTRAST DATA (Archetype 4 + Editorial)
design_archetype.vibe: Authoritative, urgent newsroom, tactile print newspaper meets high-tech AI moderation dashboard
design_archetype.theme_strategy: Light 'Newsprint' (#FAF7F2) base for public news pages with crisp crimson (#C8102E) breaking news accents; High-density dark/light hybrid studio for Admin Moderation Dashboard

headings.line_height: leading-snug (1.35 to 1.5 to accommodate Devanagari matras without clipping)
headings.usage_rules: Main H1/H2 Hindi news headlines MUST use Tiro Devanagari Hindi or Rozha One for editorial gravitas. Never use standard sans-serif for story titles.

body.font_size_min: 16px (1rem) for mobile legibility of intricate vowel marks

admin_metrics_and_code.usage_rules: Fact diff comparison, numerical statistics, timestamp metadata, watermark parameters, and status tags in Admin Dashboard

text_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug
text_hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold border-b-2 border-primary/20 pb-2
text_hierarchy.h3_card_title: text-lg sm:text-xl lg:text-2xl font-semibold leading-snug hover:text-crimson transition-colors
text_hierarchy.label_eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-crimson

public_site.badge_breaking: bg-[#C8102E] text-white font-mono text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm animate-pulse
public_site.fact_shield: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800

admin_dashboard.diff_added: bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-300 border-l-4 border-emerald-500 p-3 rounded-r-md
admin_dashboard.diff_original: bg-rose-950/40 text-rose-300 border-l-4 border-rose-500 p-3 rounded-r-md opacity-80
admin_dashboard.watermark_badge: bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 font-mono text-xs

public_homepage.hero_layout: Swiss grid asymmetrical split: 8 cols for main top breaking story with large image + 4 cols for 'ताज़ा ख़बरें' (Live Speed Feed list)
public_homepage.category_grid: Bento Grid: 1 large feature card (col-span-2) + 4 standard news cards (col-span-1) with category badges

admin_dashboard.layout: High-Density 3-Column Studio Layout: Left sidebar (Categories, Fetch Controls, API Filters) + Center pipeline list (AI Rewritten Articles with Diff View) + Right Inspector Drawer (Fact Guard Checklist, Watermark Preview, Approval Actions)

header_nav.public: Classic Newspaper Header with live date in Hindi, breaking news ticker banner, search input, category tab pills, and Admin Studio quick access button
header_nav.admin: Command Center Header with live AI Queue Status indicator, 'Manual Fetch News' trigger button, pending approval counters, and Watermark Settings modal trigger

news_card.features: AI Processed Badge, Watermarked Image with 'MyNews' branding overlay, Fact Protection Verified Tag, Category Tag, Published Time in Hindi (e.g. '10 मिनट पहले'), Bookmark & Share buttons
news_card.interactive: Hover zoom on image (scale-105 duration-300), line-clamp-2 on rewritten headline, line-clamp-3 on summary

diff_comparison_viewer.description: Side-by-side or stacked view in Admin comparing 'मूल खबर (Original English/Hindi Source)' vs 'AI रीराइट (Rewritten Clickable Hindi Header & Article)'. Highlights extracted facts (Dates, Names, Locations, Figures) in bold pill badges to ensure zero hallucination.

watermark_preview_canvas.description: Live canvas view showing how the website watermark ('MyNews' by default) is placed on top of AI-generated replacement images with opacity, position, and font size controls.

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, category tabs, approval actions, diff toggles, and news cards MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Fonts link for Devanagari fonts ('Tiro Devanagari Hindi', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', 'Rozha One') directly into index.html or top of index.css.
Implement the 'MyNews' custom watermark component over article images using CSS positioning + HTML5 Canvas so moderators can preview and change watermark text ('MyNews').
Ensure Fact Protection UI clearly highlights extracted facts (names, places, numbers, dates) in both original and rewritten texts with green badges.
Support Category Selection (e.g. देश/राजनीति, व्यापार, तकनीक, खेल, मनोरंजन, दुनिया) in both public reader feed and admin dashboard.
Provide a simulated or real News API fetching worker in backend/frontend mock with instant state updates and toast notifications via 'sonner'.
